# Rule 2.4 Do not remove yourself from the round whilst facing in-character punishment—such as jail time—or playing an important role—such as command. 
[color=lightgray]⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯⎯[/color] 

• If you have to leave, please notify admins beforehand via ahelp. You are not required to wait for a response. 

• This does not apply to cryo; however, command should generally notify other command members before leaving the round.
